claims: NASA has successfully launched the Artemis 2 mission.
The Artemis 2 mission is sending four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the Moon.
The Artemis 2 mission marks the first crewed lunar mission in 50 years.
The Orion spacecraft is currently navigating to the moon.
The Orion spacecraft followed a successful translunar injection burn.
There was a minor reported glitch with the onboard toilet fan of the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis 2 crew is en route after the successful engine burn.
The Artemis 2 mission aims to test systems for future lunar south pole landings and Mars missions.
SpaceX recently achieved a record-setting 34th flight for a Falcon 9 booster.
SpaceX recently launched a smallsat rideshare mission.
New data confirms the 2022 DART mission successfully altered the orbit of the asteroid Dimorphos.
A Chinese satellite has tested a robotic octopus arm for in-orbit refueling.
NASA is preparing to launch twin smallsat orbiters named Blue and Gold for the ESCAPADE mission.
The ESCAPADE mission is to study the Martian atmosphere.
Scientists have used the James Webb Space Telescope to create the first 3D atmospheric map of the exoplanet WASP-18b.
WASP-18b is an ultra-hot Jupiter exoplanet.
Assembly continues on the power and propulsion element for NASA’s Gateway Lunar Space Station
